mapper.select: select id, name, age, score, create_user_id as createUserId, create_username as createUsername from student order by cast(id as unsigned)
select id, name, age, score, create_user_id as createUserId, create_username as createUsername from student where id = #{id}
select id, name, age, score, create_user_id as createUserId, create_username as createUsername from student where create_user_id = #{createUserId} order by cast(id as unsigned)
mapper.insert: insert into student (id, name, age, score, create_user_id, create_username) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{age}, #{score}, #{createUserId}, #{createUsername})
